newsitem.title: ITALY: Businessman abducted in northern Italy.
newsitem.headline: Businessman abducted in northern Italy.

text.p: A businessman was abducted at gunpoint on Tuesday night by three masked men who broke into his northern Italian home, police said.
They said the alarm was raised by the wife of Giuseppe Soffiantini, 62, on Wednesday after she had managed to escape from a room that she had been locked into.
Local news media said the three armed men broke into Soffiantini's villa between Brescia and Cremona at around 10.30 p.m. and abducted the businessman after also taking valuables from the house.
Soffiantini was owner of a local textile and clothing group with around 210 employees.
